In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] '''captive''' was one of several held as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Golden Storm]] in their [[Golden Storm's hideout|hideout]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Following his release by an individual associated with the [[Blatant Beks]], the Jawa thanked them.<ref name="EO" />
